:= by
  intro k hr
  let f := fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k
  let g := fun n => ↑n * p n
  have h1 : Filter.Tendsto g Filter.atTop (nhds r) := hr
  have h2 : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ g n := by intro n; simp [g, n.choose, p, mul_nonneg]
  have h3 : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ p n := by intro n; simp [p, mul_nonneg]
  have h4 : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ f n := by intro n; simp [f, n.choose, p, pow_nonneg, mul_nonneg]
  let s := fun n => ↑(n.choose k) / ↑n ^ k
  have h5 : Filter.Tendsto s Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / ↑k.factorial)) :=
    tendsto_const_div_pow (1 : ℝ) k (by simp [k, ne_of_gt (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero k)])
  let h6 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) / ↑n ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds (1 / ↑k.factorial)) := h5
  let h7 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds (r ^ k / ↑k.factorial)) :=
    Filter.tendsto.prod_mk (Filter.tendsto.const_nhds r) h6
  exact h7
